claims.text: The paper explores models including convolutional neural network (CNN), recurrent neural network (RNN), feed-forward neural network (FFNN), long-short term memory (LSTM), and logistic regression.
The study also includes a newer model called TraceMiner, which utilizes an LSTM-RNN architecture.
In total, the paper compares 15 models derived from 5 different models fed with 3 different pre-training representations.
